# Behavioural modelling

Behavioural features are measurement-derived summaries. A detected statistical state change is **not automatically a stress response** or a welfare diagnosis.

<p class="aqt-figure-caption">Conceptual visualization only; no physiological or welfare class labels are implied.</p>

## Choose an analysis by scientific question

| Question | Available methods | Important assumption |
|---|---|---|
| Did the mean of a feature change? | [`aqt_state_changepoint()`](../reference/aqt_state_changepoint.html) | Descriptive segmentation with penalty and supported timestamps |
| How do supplied latent states explain observations? | [`aqt_hmm_decode()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_decode.html) | Gaussian state means, SDs and transition model are supplied |
| Can transition probabilities be learned? | [`aqt_hmm_transition_fit()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_transition_fit.html) | State emission means/SDs remain externally specified |
| How does a model generalize? | [`aqt_hmm_holdout_score()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_holdout_score.html) | Hold out genuinely independent tanks as appropriate |
| Can we test known synthetic recovery? | [`aqt_hmm_simulate_truth()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_simulate_truth.html), [`aqt_hmm_recovery_audit()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_recovery_audit.html) | Synthetic truth does not establish real welfare validity |
| What changes around logged interventions? | [`aqt_hmm_event_tank_epochs()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_event_tank_epochs.html), [`aqt_hmm_tank_event_contrast()`](../reference/aqt_hmm_tank_event_contrast.html) | Complete supported epochs and independent treatment tanks |
| Are smooth trajectory modes shared? | [`aqt_trajectory_grid_pca()`](../reference/aqt_trajectory_grid_pca.html), [`aqt_sparse_fpca_fit()`](../reference/aqt_sparse_fpca_fit.html) | Dense grids differ from sparse, irregular functional estimation |
| Are event curves correlated within fish? | [`aqt_functional_longitudinal_fit()`](../reference/aqt_functional_longitudinal_fit.html) | Nested tank/fish model assumptions and within-fish correlation |

## Gaussian HMM interpretation

A Gaussian HMM can attach probabilities to abstract, analyst-specified states based on a time series such as speed. It does not automatically estimate externally valid biological categories such as **fear**, **positive welfare**, **hunger** or **stress**.

Recorded observation steps may occur at uneven temporal intervals. A per-step transition probability should not be presented as a continuous-time transition rate without a matching model.

## Gap-safe trajectories

Tracking loss, segmentation failures and long observation gaps need explicit handling. No interpolation should silently convert a 4-second disappearance into a continuously observed path.

Read [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/GAUSSIAN_HMM_BEHAVIOURAL_STATES.md), [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/HMM_TRANSITION_HOLDOUT.md), [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/FUNCTIONAL_LONGITUDINAL_NLME.md) and [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/SPARSE_HIERARCHICAL_METHODS.md).

## Plotting and reporting

Use [`aqt_plot_changepoints()`](../reference/aqt_plot_changepoints.html), [`aqt_plot_grid_pca()`](../reference/aqt_plot_grid_pca.html) and [`aqt_plot_speed_response()`](../reference/aqt_plot_speed_response.html) where the stated data contracts are satisfied. Report the source signal, time window, state names as *analyst-defined*, and independent biological validation separately.
